overview.title: About the project
overview.description: Mobile personal cabinet for subscribers of Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Chelyabinsk. Replaces office visits: meter reading submission, gas payments, service requests — all through the app.

solution.title: What was built
solution.description: Cross-platform React Native app for gas utility subscribers.

features.title: Readings and payments
features.description: Gas meter reading submission, card payments, payment history and receipts.

features.title: Online service requests
features.description: Applications for gas connection, technical conditions, meter installation, appointment scheduling — no office visit needed.

features.title: Personal cabinet
features.description: Contract information, service history, consumption data.

impact.title: Outcome
impact.description: The app digitized routine gas services for residents of Chelyabinsk region.

achievements.title: No office visits
achievements.description: Core operations — readings, payments, requests — available 24/7 from the app

achievements.title: Gazprom infrastructure integration
achievements.description: Connected to the corporate systems of the gas distribution company
